policy: Shared nonlegendary M21 red frame pigment only. Fit on seven calibration names; ten reserved names and twenty-five additional names use the same frozen curve. All references are reused development data. Scan-only v2 poses, ink-free rail samples, mean color and ordered texture checks are frozen. The new ordinary-profile table preserves earlier crown and paper treatments. Both current and raw-source gates pass in every cohort; no per-card renderer fitting. Typography, paper, crowns, mana, artwork and whole-card certification remain separate.

native.policy: All 292 ordinary nonfoil M21 cards, with printing-sourced original rules in both renderer revisions. Full current-painter replay; exact-input original baselines reuse their verified native capture or replay the published 0.4.3 painter. Only 42 nonlegendary red component pigments change. Central art/paper, outer stock and silhouette alpha remain identical. Color/texture features equal the previously gated native candidate exactly. This is regression evidence, not whole-card accuracy certification.

rows.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

compatibility.policy: All historical palette selectors, early-core controls, 292 original-wording M21 printings, 13 actual legendary lands and 52 synthetic/disabled controls. Only ordinary nonlegendary M21 red pigment may change. Every mana/stock target and all other materials must be identical

visualReview.selection: Largest regression, largest absolute candidate error, and largest improvement. Original rules supplied in both rebuilds. Scan/current/candidate columns.
visualReview.result: The shared red pigment improves the ordinary set median while keeping texture. Fiery Emancipation is the largest accepted regional regression (1.18). Chandra’s Firemaw has the largest remaining regional error (3.90) and visibly different reference tint; retain it for printing-batch/reference review. Its paper/plate, art and text differences are independent. Unleash Fury is the largest improvement. Original wording is supplied to both rebuilds.
